name: Remote Library
description: Synchronize and stream libraries from multiple remote Jellyfin servers without downloading their media.
overview: Multi-server remote Jellyfin library pointers with local-first deduplication.

versions.changelog: Add multi-source metadata and inherited season attribution, rank remote sources by online status and measured latency, expose source-health explanations, and eliminate duplicate poster badges when GLaDOS UI is active.
Add an enabled-by-default You Might Like home row that blends local and remote Jellyfin recommendations with Seerr, with a plugin settings toggle.
Require a real playable media source before creating movie or episode pointers, preventing virtual, missing, calendar-only, special, and extra metadata from becoming phantom library items.
Remove stale loop pointers without offline peers blocking cleanup, and automatically reconcile media after every startup or plugin upgrade.
Remove stale loop pointers even when another remote server is offline, preserving only pointers owned by that offline server; run media sync on startup by default.
Prevent remote pointers being re-exported through legacy or incompatible peers when they cannot provide a managed-media manifest.
Sync movie and episode runtimes for Ends At, ensure show source badges match selected episode pointers, and adopt GPL-2.0-or-later.
Sync movie and episode runtimes for Ends At, and ensure show source badges match the server supplying selected episode pointers.
First stable release with configurable sync intervals and reliable remote calendar synchronization.
First stable release with configurable sync intervals and reliable remote calendar synchronization.
